title: Qakkaloysi cogdah addat yunkuttube
intro: ucsub soolo xaqut muuci amixxige waytam miracles hinnay amoytiinitte, takkay immay qangor uxih sorkocobaxitte miraacissa asaaku. Ta Yallih taama abeyna gaalik tan acwa geeh, kicna qunxa barteenah yeceenih yanin kulli fayul gadda gey.
clues: Yalli qilmi yoo yoofeeh, wohul faatitah axcuk amriseh.
Anu inni baxa lih racmattale fayitteey, kacanuu kee bohoy luk maabitina luk yaabe.
Anu inni baxah Yallat wakliita haysittaanam kaxxa hoxa kinnim warseh suge.
Anu inni baxa salat akah yakkennah, gitat amrisaanam, qellat waasaanam kee sabrit yabbixeenimih fayse.
Anu inni baxah xabanak kaxxiinit mafakkiimam kee ardi bagul kaxxiinit akah gexannah maabitina abe.
Anu inni baxa fanti caddoh sissikaane kee xongolo salcisaanam barseh, sabab akak qilsi xongoloola danan xongolo kinni.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
